resources.string: Version — one game build (an APK). The same build can back several launch entries; the files are not copied.
Slot — one isolated set of game data (saves / settings / mods). One slot is one data folder; two entries on the same slot overwrite each other\'s saves.
Launch entry (instance) — a version plus a slot; one row on the main page. Changing its slot or name affects that row only.
Current slot — the slot the next game launch will read; it is shown at the top of the main page.
Default slot — the slot that newly imported versions, and any version without a slot of its own, follow.
Backup — a snapshot of what is in a slot, restorable at any time; backups share content, so they take little space.
Transfer station — deleted or replaced files move here first and can be put back (old ones are trimmed by policy).
Whole-slot export / import — pack a whole slot into one zip (for moving devices), or import one back into a slot.
Everything inside a slot lives under \"Saves and backups\".
